description: Unit tests for the ControlBackend component, testing control creation, registration, application state handling, and cleanup.

classes.name: ControlBackendTests
classes.description: Test fixture class for ControlBackend unit tests, setting up mocks and the system under test.

methods.name: ShouldFailToStartWhenControlIsNull
methods.description: Test that ControlBackend fails to start when control creation returns null.

methods.name: ShouldFailToStartWhenRegisterClientFails
methods.description: Test that ControlBackend fails to start when control registration fails.

methods.name: ShouldSkipWaitingForRunningWhenRunningStateWasSetDuringInitialisation
methods.description: Test that waitForRunning returns true if the application state was set to RUNNING during registration.

methods.name: ShouldSkipWaitingForRunningWhenRunningStateWasSetEarlier
methods.description: Test that waitForRunning returns true if the application state was set to RUNNING before calling wait.

methods.name: ShouldFailToWaitForRunning
methods.description: Test that waitForRunning returns false if the application state remains INACTIVE.

methods.name: ShouldRemoveControlBackend
methods.description: Test that removeControlBackend properly cleans up the control backend.
